summary: WisdomTree, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 31, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.03 per share payable August 26, 2026. The filing includes routine earnings information, record AUM of $162.9 billion, and adjusted EPS. No special-situation event (M&A, activist, strategic review, etc.) is present; the dividend is ordinary and recurring. The item references a prior acquisition of Atlantic House Holdings but is not a current transaction. This is a standard earnings and dividend announcement, thus no special-situation classification applies.
